# `{upxdvir}` Math Demo

**Note**: This is not fully functional yet. Unexpected behaviour may be encountered.

```{r imports, message = FALSE}
library(grid)
library(upxdvir)
```

```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
source("demo-helpers.R")
setKnitrPresets()
```

## Fraction

```{r frac}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex("全体の $\\frac{1}{2}$ は $x$ です。")
```

## Exponentials
```{r exp}
grid.uplatex("$1^2$ のグラフです。")
```
